tha-ap347:1.1: himavantassāvidūre → himavantassa avidūre (bj) | himavantassāvidūre hārito → himavantassavidūre hāriko (sya-all)
tha-ap347:2.1: naḷāgāraṁ → nalāgāraṁ (pts) | Nalāgāraṁ → G. nāḷāgāraṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap347:3.4: devarajjaṁ akārayiṁ catusattatikkhattuñca → devarajjamakārayiṁ sattasattatikkhattuñca (bj) | devarajjaṁ akārayiṁ catusattatikkhattuñca cakkavattī → devarajjamakārayiṁ sattasattatikkhattuñca cakkavatti (sya-all)
tha-ap347:4.1: sattasattatikkhattuñca → catusattatikkhattuñca (bj: machasaṁ) | Catusattati → sattasattati (cck: sī.)
tha-ap347:5.4: sapabhassaraṁ → sapabhasasaraṁ (bj) | sapabhassaraṁ dve sampattī anubhotvā → sappabhassaraṁ dvesampattiṁ anubhotvāna (sya-all) | sa-pabhassaraṁ → S1 vimānassa pabhaṅkaraṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap347:6.1: sampattī → sampatti (bj) | anubhotvā → G. S1 anubhutvā. (pts note)
tha-ap347:7.1: padhānapahitattomhi → padhānaṁ pahitattomhi (sya-all, pts) | pahitatto → G. padhāna-. (pts note)
